title: Illustrative worker memory model
method: Assumed resident memory = 350 MiB idle + 80 MiB per concurrent document. Compare with a 600 MiB process budget. Measure actual peaks; the model excludes nonlinear allocator, cache and runtime effects.
alt: Illustrative worker memory model. Idle: 350 MiB; Two concurrent documents: 510 MiB; Four concurrent documents: 670 MiB. Illustrative inputs.
